niche.diet: Carnivore; blood, lymph, and skin secretions of grazers.

links: Dense air (D4) exerts 1.6x wind force per m/s

skill.effect: The creature clings tightly to its host and rarely falls off when moving. You will see it maintain a firm grip even during rapid motion.

journal.en: They do not blow away; they become part of the herd's shadow.

plausibility.summary: Keep the flat carapace; reconcile flavour text with physics: on-host they stay anchored; a meadow crosswind can still strip unattached individuals (your haunting moment is fine if only migrants/off-host animals lift — not animals glued to fur).

Sustained blood meals from large hosts

skill.effect: The creature feeds on its host and weakens it. If applied before courtship, the creature's presence strongly appeals to the target.

chains.weakness: Leaves a visible puncture; host grooming removes them.

journal.en: A sip here, a sip there, until the giant stumbles.

links: Avoids midday desiccation and DNA damage
Active at dawn/dusk, hides under grass blades at noon

skill.effect: The creature moves swiftly during the early morning hours. Its pace slows considerably as the day reaches its peak heat.

chains.weakness: Immobilized by sudden rain or heavy fog.

journal.en: They wear the sun's warning color and hide when it is brightest.

plausibility.summary: Cite F14 for meadow UV (moderate, not super-Earth extreme); keep dawn/dusk activity + grass-shelter at noon. Red-purple pigment can echo slope-plant honest signalling (F25) as convergent parasite camouflage among vetirroja/red-vein meadow plants.

links: Scent molecules diffuse slower in still, humid air (D18)
Long-lasting trails in morning fog guide them to herds

skill.effect: The creature tracks its host and reveals their hidden position through the grass. You will see the location marked for a short while.

chains.weakness: Useless in strong crosswinds or heavy rain.

journal.en: Morning fog is their highway. In the thick white air, they read scent trails like roads leading straight to the herds.

plausibility.summary: None required; game '15 s reveal' is a fair compression of plume-following in fog, not literal teleporting knowledge.

relations.note: Feeds on blood and skin secretions from Rondo herds.
Alula picks them off host fur and grass blades.

secrets: Observe 3 Pellizcador clusters on a Rondo. Unlocks move: 'Scent track' (Poke) and reveals their role in the food web.
moments: During a Rondo migration, a sudden crosswind strips the meadow floor. Thousands of Pellizcadores lift off like black dust, catching the thermal updrafts to ride ahead of the herd, a silent, drifting cloud seeking the next meal.

journal.en: They do not bite; they sip. Their stylets vanish into the fur, leaving only a pinprick and a thirst.
Morning fog is their highway. In the thick white air, they read scent trails like roads leading straight to the herds.
